WITH per AS (SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date s, period_end_date e FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period=8 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26')),

SELECT per.fiscal_year,

 sum(CASE WHEN CAST(loc AS DATE) BETWEEN per.s AND per.e AND NOT staff_purchase_flag THEN net_amount END) nonstaff_local,
 sum(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e AND category='ZZ Test' THEN net_amount END) zz,
 sum(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e AND channel_id IS NULL THEN net_amount END) nullchan,
 sum(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e AND quantity<=0 THEN net_amount END) negq,
 sum(CASE WHEN sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e AND net_amount<0 THEN net_amount END) negamt
FROM b JOIN per ON b.sale_date BETWEEN per.s - 1 AND per.e + 1 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

calls.statement:
WITH per AS (
  SELECT fiscal_year, period_start_date AS s, period_end_date AS e
  FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
  WHERE fiscal_period = 8 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25', 'FY2025/26')),
cur AS (
  SELECT p.product_key, c.category
  FROM dim_product p
  JOIN (SELECT sku, category FROM dim_product WHERE is_current) c ON c.sku = p.sku
  WHERE c.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')),
sales AS (
  SELECT per.fiscal_year, cur.category, sum(f.net_amount) AS sales_net
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN per ON f.sale_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e
  JOIN cur ON cur.product_key = f.product_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND f.channel_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'ST'
  WHERE coalesce(o.status, 'ok') <> 'cancelled'
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
rets AS (
  SELECT per.fiscal_year, cur.category, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN per ON r.return_date BETWEEN per.s AND per.e
  JOIN cur ON cur.product_key = r.product_key
  GROUP BY 1, 2),
net AS (
  SELECT s.fiscal_year, s.category, s.sales_net - coalesce(t.refunds_net, 0) AS net_sales
  FROM sales s LEFT JOIN rets t ON t.fiscal_year = s.fiscal_year AND t.category = s.category)
SELECT n.category, 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 8 AS fiscal_period,
  round(n.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
  round(p.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_year_before,
  round(100.0 * (n.net_sales - p.net_sales) / p.net_sales, 1) AS growth_pct
FROM net n JOIN net p ON p.category = n.category AND p.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25'
WHERE n.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
ORDER BY n.category
